mentions.name: Denver Brooms Day
mentions.description: This service sends reminders to move your car before street sweeping days in Denver, using the same season pass model with free email alerts and paid per-season text alerts.
mentions.source_excerpt: On its way, likely first ship today: https://denverbroomsday.com, same season pass model with same free email/paid-per-season text split on reminders to move your car before street sweeping days in Denver.
mentions.author: Arubis
